name: S3-compatible storage
description: Keeps encrypted copies of your COGNIX[WS] backups in an S3 bucket: Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, MinIO, AWS S3 or any S3-compatible storage. COGNIX[WS] encrypts everything before it leaves this computer; the storage never sees what is inside.

settings.label: Storage address
settings.description: The S3 address of your storage. Cloudflare R2: https://<account id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Backblaze B2: https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com. AWS: https://s3.<region>.amazonaws.com. Plain http only for this computer or your home network.

settings.label: Bucket
settings.description: An existing bucket, used only for these copies.

settings.label: Region
settings.description: auto for Cloudflare R2; the bucket's region elsewhere, like us-east-1 or eu-central-003.

settings.label: Folder in the bucket
settings.description: Optional. Copies go under this folder instead of the bucket's top.

settings.label: Access key ID
settings.description: From your storage's API keys. Give the key read and write access to this bucket only. Stored protected on this computer.

settings.label: Secret access key
settings.description: Shown once when you create the key. Stored protected on this computer.

settings.label: Never delete here
settings.description: Keep every copy in this bucket even when a destination allows deleting old copies. Choose this when the key cannot delete, or the bucket's own rules remove old files.
